Loads the graph entity rows needed for layout as a snapshot. Versioned storage can supply a branch-cached batch; ordinary storage uses separate entity queries. Later layout stages transform this snapshot, while the context cache avoids repeated database reads.

* 2. derive-fn-slot-views
:PROPERTIES:
:CUSTOM_ID: layout/derive-fn-slot-views
:FILE: src/graphden/layout/data.clj
:LINE: 275

Derives each function's visible argument rows from inherited [[file:glossary.org::#term/slot][slots]] and effective [[file:glossary.org::#term/binding][bindings]]. Nearer [[file:glossary.org::#term/binding][bindings]] override more distant ones. ~:source-id~ retains the declaring ancestor's provenance for inherited [[file:glossary.org::#term/slot][slots]]; it is not simply the current displayed function ID.

* 3. build-graph-elements
:PROPERTIES:
:CUSTOM_ID: layout/build-graph-elements
:FILE: src/graphden/layout/graph.clj
:LINE: 944
:MINS: 5.6
:END:

Walks the requested node expansions with cycle protection and collects graph elements. Post-processing adds optional-argument and [[file:glossary.org::#term/hof][HOF]] badges, adjusts captured-argument edges, removes duplicate overlays, and attaches display facts. The result supplies the client's node and edge lists.

Adds placeholders for required public inputs reached through bound references, including required [[file:glossary.org::#term/hof][HOF]] [[file:glossary.org::#term/capture][captures]] reported by ~surface/public-free-entries~. Optional [[file:glossary.org::#term/capture][captures]] do not create required holes. The placeholder keeps the inner [[file:glossary.org::#term/slot][slot]] identity while targeting the root function so [[file:glossary.org::#term/binding][binding]] an input matches the Run form's public argument model.

- source :: [[file:../../../src/graphden/layout/builder_helpers.clj::(defn emit-root-deep-frees!][src/graphden/layout/builder_helpers.clj:1130]]

* 5. compute-layout-matrix

:CUSTOM_ID: layout/compute-layout-matrix
:FILE: src/graphden/layout/core.clj
:LINE: 308
:MINS: 1.8

Assigns graph elements to grid columns and rows and reports layout validation results. The browser later measures actual card sizes and converts the grid into pixel coordinates. This separates graph ordering from DOM-dependent geometry.

* 6. annotate
:PROPERTIES:
:CUSTOM_ID: layout/annotate
:FILE: src/graphden/layout/strip_facts.clj
:LINE: 85
:MINS: 2.3

Attaches computed facts to function nodes: the inherited return-type alias, the [[file:glossary.org::#term/base-function][base function]] owning a return-type rule, and the ancestor responsible for [[file:glossary.org::#term/branch-local][branch-local]] behavior. The editor displays these server-computed facts instead of repeating the same traversals in JavaScript.
